entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: Machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and ML algorithms such as classification, regression, clustering, and dimensional reduction
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning models using SciPy and ScikitLearn
Deploying machine learning algorithms and pipelines on Apache Spark
Deep learning models and neural networks using Keras, PyTorch, and TensorFlow
Large language modeling and generative AI applications
Natural language processing, computer vision, image and video processing, text analytics, and recommender systems
Transfer learning in NLP with LangChain, Hugging Face, and PyTorch
Building a QA bot with LangChain and LLM, and Gradio interfaces
reading.format: Professional Certificate delivered as a 13 course series. The page says learners complete hands-on labs and projects and practical evaluations. It is available in 19 languages.
reading.summary: The IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate is a 13 course series offered by IBM on Coursera. It is intended to build AI engineering skills and practical experience. The program covers machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI through labs and projects. Completing it earns a career credential that demonstrates expertise.
reading.audience: The page says it is ideal for data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists who want to become job-ready as an AI engineer.
